meta.tagline: Discover a whole new world of magic, wishes, and unexpected destiny in vibrant Agrabah.
description: In the bustling desert city of Agrabah, kind-hearted street urchin Aladdin spends his days surviving by his wits alongside his loyal monkey companion, Abu. His life changes forever after a chance encounter with Princess Jasmine, who has snuck out of the palace seeking freedom from rigid traditions. Drawn to her bravery and charm, Aladdin finds himself caught in a grand intrigue when the power-hungry royal vizier, Jafar, seeks a legendary artifact hidden deep within the treacherous Cave of Wonders.

Tasked with retrieving an ancient magic lamp, Aladdin inadvertently unleashes a charismatic and powerful Genie who offers to grant him three wishes. Posing as a wealthy prince to win Jasmine's heart, Aladdin must navigate complex court dynamics and hide his true identity. However, as Jafar's relentless pursuit of supreme power threatens the entire realm, Aladdin must look beyond magical illusions and discover his inner courage to save the kingdom and the person he loves.
